features.name: --api-key
features.purpose: Require an API key from clients.
features.note: Set a key when clients must authenticate to the server.

features.name: --cache-disk
features.purpose: Set the disk prompt cache directory.
features.note: Opt in for fast restarts; model bytes are verified once, then a stamp skips later hashes.

features.name: --cache-disk-bytes
features.purpose: Limit disk prompt cache storage.
features.note: Keep 8 GiB unless the disk cache must retain more prompt snapshots.

features.name: --cache-disk-staging-bytes
features.purpose: Limit RAM used to stage disk prompt snapshots.
features.note: Keep automatic sizing unless disk persistence needs a different RAM limit.

features.name: --cache-ram-bytes
features.purpose: Set the RAM snapshot cache budget.
features.note: Keep the profile limit unless available host RAM requires a smaller cache.

features.name: --context
features.purpose: Set the context token limit for each session.
features.note: Keep the profile context unless the task requires a different token limit.

features.name: --frequency-penalty
features.purpose: Penalize tokens by their generated occurrence count.
features.note: Keep zero unless the task needs fewer frequently repeated tokens.

features.name: --host
features.purpose: Set the server listen address.
features.note: Keep the local address unless remote clients must connect to the server.

features.name: --loop-breaker
features.purpose: Stop repeated answer and thinking loops.
features.note: Keep on unless repeated text handling needs a comparison with it off.

features.name: --max-tokens
features.purpose: Limit new tokens generated per request.
features.note: Keep unlimited generation unless responses need a fixed new token limit.

features.name: --min-keep
features.purpose: Retain a minimum number of sampling candidates.
features.note: Keep zero unless probability filters must retain a minimum number of candidates.

features.name: --min-p
features.purpose: Filter tokens by probability relative to the best token.
features.note: Keep zero unless the task needs minimum probability filtering.

features.name: --mmproj
features.purpose: Set the vision sidecar file.
features.note: Set the matching vision sidecar when the model must process images.

features.name: --model
features.purpose: Control model.
features.note: Inventory classification.

features.name: --no-cache-disk
features.purpose: Disable the disk snapshot cache.
features.note: Enable it when the supplied disk cache directory must be ignored.

features.name: --no-twin
features.purpose: Suppress the manifest dense twin.
features.note: Turn the prepared dense twin off to release its model storage; a device-memory delta was not measured.

features.name: --no-vision
features.purpose: Suppress the manifest vision sidecar.
features.note: Enable it when the server must omit the vision sidecar.

features.name: --npu-prefill
features.purpose: Use NPU prefill when available.
features.note: Keep on when available for long prompt prefill; the GPU path takes over if NPU startup fails.

features.name: --port
features.purpose: Set the server listen port.
features.note: Keep 8080 unless another service uses that port or clients require a different port.

features.name: --presence-penalty
features.purpose: Penalize tokens already generated in the response.
features.note: Keep the model preset unless the task needs a different penalty for previously generated tokens.

features.name: --profile
features.purpose: Select the release settings profile.
features.note: Keep default for normal use, select subagents for concurrency, or select exact for reproducibility.

features.name: --reasoning-effort
features.purpose: Set the default reasoning effort.
features.note: Keep medium unless the task requires a different reasoning effort.

features.name: --repeat-last-n
features.purpose: Set the recent token window for repetition penalties.
features.note: Keep 64 unless repetition penalties need a different recent token window.

features.name: --repeat-penalty
features.purpose: Penalize recently used tokens.
features.note: Keep one unless the task needs a penalty for recent repeated tokens.

features.name: --seed
features.purpose: Set the random sampling seed.
features.note: Use a nonnegative seed for reproducibility; exact uses one unless another nonnegative seed is supplied.

features.name: --served-model-name
features.purpose: Set the model identifier exposed by the API.
features.note: Set a name when clients require a model identifier different from the model file name.

features.name: --sessions
features.purpose: Set the number of preallocated request sessions.
features.note: Keep one for exact output or select subagents when four requests must run concurrently.

features.name: --temperature
features.purpose: Set the randomness of token sampling.
features.note: Keep the model preset unless the task needs different randomness or greedy decoding with zero.

features.name: --think
features.purpose: Set the default reasoning mode.
features.note: Keep on unless the task does not need reasoning.

features.name: --think-marker-bias
features.purpose: Set a fixed thinking marker probability bias.
features.note: Keep zero unless the task needs a fixed thinking marker bias.

features.name: --top-k
features.purpose: Limit sampling to the highest probability candidates.
features.note: Keep the model preset unless the task needs a different sampling candidate limit.

features.name: --top-p
features.purpose: Filter sampling candidates by cumulative probability.
features.note: Keep the model preset unless the task needs a different cumulative probability limit.

features.name: --twin-model
features.purpose: Select the prepared dense twin.
features.note: Use the prepared twin; speed was measured with the draft head, while device memory cost remains unmeasured.

features.name: GUFO_MAX_IMAGE_TOKENS
features.purpose: Limit image tokens admitted for a request.
features.note: Keep it unset unless image token admission needs a fixed limit.

advanced.name: --draft-head-model
advanced.purpose: Select the prepared MTP draft head.
advanced.note: Select the prepared MTP draft head.

advanced.name: --draft-tokens
advanced.purpose: Set the maximum speculative draft length.
advanced.note: Keep seven tokens unless speculative draft length tests require another value.

advanced.name: --min-draft-tokens
advanced.purpose: Set the minimum speculative draft length.
advanced.note: Keep one token unless speculative draft tests require a larger minimum.

advanced.name: --mtp-draft-vocab
advanced.purpose: Select the MTP draft head vocabulary.
advanced.note: Keep the profile vocabulary unless draft vocabulary tests require another setting.

advanced.name: --mtp-model
advanced.note: Set the matching MTP sidecar when speculative decoding is required.

advanced.name: --mtp-policy
advanced.purpose: Select the MTP draft length controller.
advanced.note: Keep survival unless draft acceptance tests require the length policy.

advanced.name: --no-draft-head
advanced.purpose: Suppress the manifest draft output head.
advanced.note: Enable it when MTP must run without the supplied draft head.

advanced.name: --no-mtp
advanced.purpose: Disable MTP defaults and the speculative backend.
advanced.note: Enable it when decoding must run without MTP.

advanced.name: --no-prompt-lookup
advanced.note: Keep prompt lookup enabled with MTP unless lookup comparisons require it off.

advanced.name: --prefill-chunk
advanced.purpose: Limit prompt tokens between active decode rounds.
advanced.note: Keep 512 unless active sessions need shorter pauses during another request prefill.

advanced.name: --prompt-lookup
advanced.purpose: Propose tokens from an earlier conversation match.
advanced.note: Keep it enabled with MTP unless prompt lookup comparisons require it off.

advanced.name: --speculative
advanced.default_text: mtp with an MTP sidecar; otherwise off
advanced.note: Keep MTP with its sidecar or select off when plain autoregressive decoding is required.

advanced.name: --verify-model
advanced.purpose: Hash all eight manifest files plus distinct overrides before loading (about 2-4 minutes on SSD).
advanced.note: Use full verification to detect payload corruption before loading.

advanced.name: GUFO_DRAFT_OUT_MODEL
advanced.purpose: Select the four bit output head used for MTP drafts.
advanced.note: Set the matching draft head when faster MTP decoding outside exact is required.

advanced.name: GUFO_EXPERT_V2K
advanced.note: Keep this experimental kernel off except for decode kernel comparisons.

advanced.name: GUFO_LENIENT
advanced.purpose: Accept near miss MTP drafts inside thinking spans.
advanced.note: Keep bounded outside exact unless strict speculative acceptance is required.

advanced.name: GUFO_LENIENT_LAMBDA
advanced.purpose: Set the lenient speculative acceptance bound.
advanced.note: Keep the default unless lenient acceptance tests require a different bound.

advanced.name: GUFO_PREFILL_FORWARD_TOKENS
advanced.purpose: Set the maximum tokens in each prefill forward pass.
advanced.note: Keep 4096 unless prefill geometry tests outside exact require a different pass size.

advanced.name: GUFO_ROUTED_LANEROW
advanced.purpose: Enable the routed expert prefill kernel.
advanced.note: Keep the profile setting unless routed expert kernel comparisons require a different setting outside exact.
